extracted.intended_audience: CIA administrative officials / approving officials responsible for confidential funds (OSA forward base administrators)
extracted.subtask_short: approving admin procedures for forward bases
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for submitting and approving administrative procedures and expenditures (including per diem) for OSA forward bases, emphasizing per‑base requests, audit‑resistant justification, and adherence to authorities and applicable laws/policies/regulations. Targets resubmission requirements when a blanket approval is not acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: No blanket approvals; require specific and explicit individual requests
rubrics_metrics.description: While in principle we were in favor of the philosophy expounded in the reference, we did not feel that under the authorities and responsibilities vested in an approving official of confidential funds that we could honestly approve such a 'blanket' approval without having a specific and explicit request on an individual basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Blanket or generic requests for administrative procedures at multiple forward bases are not acceptable; each base must be the subject of its own specific, explicit approval request so the approving official can satisfy their authorities/responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit separate per diem proposal for each base
rubrics_metrics.description: Please resubmit your request with a separate proposal of requested per diem for each base.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Per‑diem amounts must be proposed on a per‑base basis rather than as a lump or blanket figure; this enables review and justification tailored to conditions at each location.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantiate any out‑of‑ordinary requests with audit‑resistant justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantiate any request out of the ordinary with justification that you feel could withstand any challenge by auditors and others responsible for seeing that we are complying with applicable laws, policies, regulations and procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For deviations or atypical funding/expense proposals provide documentation and rationale sufficient to survive audit scrutiny and show clear compliance with legal/policy/regulatory requirements; anticipate challenges from auditors and compliance officials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure requests fall within the approving official's authorities and responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Approving officials must act within the authorities and responsibilities vested in them for confidential funds; approval decisions should reflect those limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before submitting or approving proposals, verify that the requested actions and expenditures are within the legal and delegated authority of the approving official; if not, obtain specific higher authorization or reframe the request accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate compliance with applicable laws, policies, regulations and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests and accompanying justifications must demonstrate compliance with applicable laws, policies, regulations and procedures governing confidential funds and administrative operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documentation should explicitly reference relevant rules or procedures and explain how the proposal meets them, enabling auditors and oversight bodies to confirm conformity.
